principle: DO NOT SCALE. REFLOW. Tokens change per semantic viewport; screens never redefine them.

breakpoints.rule: No per-screen breakpoints. CSS uses exactly @media (min-width: 700px) and @media (min-width: 1024px) (+ the tablet-only range 700–1023).

unit.MOBILE: --u: calc(100vw / 853) — authority units, pixel-locked to the phone authorities
unit.TABLET: --u: clamp(0.84px, 100vw / 834, 1px) — panel internals at the master's 1u ≈ 1px

contentWidths.rule: No universal max-width (never 768px). Content fills the workspace up to a page-type measure; the hero band is always full-bleed across the workspace.
contentWidths.staffWorkspace: viewport − NAV_WIDTH; content padding max(PAGE_GUTTER, (workspace − 1480px) / 2) → content measure caps at 1480px on very wide screens
contentWidths.singleColumnFlow: 1000px, centred (a working flow without a side column)

typographyRoles.case: UPPERCASE everywhere (founder law); password inputs are the only exception

ctaRules.primary: One gold primary action per screen. Never several equal gold buttons side by side (path-card arrows are navigation affordances, not page actions).
ctaRules.MOBILE: authority geometry (full-width bar at the authority position)
ctaRules.TABLET: page action: as wide as the panels above it (full content width), 58px tall; inside a card: full card width (founder note 2026-10-08; was centred min(456px, 100%))
ctaRules.DESKTOP: LANDING: workspace-wide bar 47px tall · MAIN_SIDE / CANVAS_PANEL: full width of the sticky side column, under any panel set beside the work (AioAside: BULK BATCH puts CLIENT DETECTION there, stacked portrait) · one column (narrow workspace): as wide as the panels above it

color.gold: #f1c158 → #e7ab3c gradient (CTA, current step, active nav accent)
